name: Liofilchem
description: Liofilchem, Italy, offers culture media and antimicrobial susceptibility testing (AST) products for clinical and industrial microbiology. For Indian laboratories, its portfolio supports microbial isolation and susceptibility assessment, helping teams inform treatment decisions and maintain microbiological quality-control workflows.
products: Culture media (ready-to-use plates, tubes, bottles), antimicrobial susceptibility discs and strips, rapid diagnostic kits

name: Sacace Biotechnologies
description: Sacace, Italy, develops PCR kits for molecular testing, supporting the detection of clinically relevant targets. Available through BioAzure, its portfolio helps Indian referral laboratories and hospitals build molecular diagnostic workflows around their testing needs.
products: Real-time PCR kits, conventional PCR kits, DNA/RNA extraction kits, molecular diagnostics reagents

name: ViennaLab Diagnostics
description: ViennaLab, Austria, offers StripAssay genotyping solutions for targeted genetic testing. Its strip-based format supports the identification of defined genetic variants, helping Indian laboratories develop focused testing services without relying on sequencing for every application.
products: StripAssay kits (pharmacogenetics, cardiovascular, HLA), RealFast PCR kits, PGX genotyping panels

name: Micreos Food Safety BV
description: Micreos, Netherlands, provides PhageGuard bacteriophage solutions for targeted control of foodborne pathogens. For Indian food companies, these solutions complement existing food-safety measures, supporting pathogen-reduction strategies and efforts to meet customer and market requirements.
products: PhageGuard Listex (anti-Listeria), PhageGuard S (anti-Salmonella), bacteriophage-based biocontrol solutions

name: Medix Biochemica Oy
description: Medix Biochemica, Finland, supplies IVD raw materials for diagnostic assay development and manufacturing. For Indian IVD manufacturers and R&D teams, its portfolio supports the selection of critical assay components, with a focus on analytical performance and consistency as products move toward commercial production.
products: Monoclonal antibodies, polyclonal antibodies, antigens, enzymes (HRP, AP), blocking reagents

name: Candor Bioscience
description: Candor Bioscience, Germany, part of the Medix Biochemica group, offers solutions for immunoassay optimization. Its reagents help Indian assay developers address nonspecific binding, background signal and reagent stability, supporting the development of robust diagnostic assays.
products: LowCross-Buffer, Assay Defender, sample diluents, blocking solutions, stabilizers for ELISA and lateral flow
